articles.text: 150 YEARS AFTER BELL PATENTED THE TELEPHONE, AT&T TO DISCONTINUE LANDLINE ACCESS IN CALIFORNIA. This year marks the 150th anniversary of Alexander Graham Bell's 1876 telephone patent. Now, after a century and a half of continuous telephone service, many Californians have only days remaining to order a traditional copper landline before AT&T plans to stop accepting new orders on July 19, 2026.

articles.text: AT&T (T) Tests 5G Drone Sensing That Points Toward Future 6G Uses. AT&T (NYSE:T) and Ericsson completed a live test of advanced 5G network sensing for drone detection. The trial used existing 5G infrastructure with AI-driven algorithms to detect, locate, and track drones in real time.
